resources.string:
For the keyboard to work, you need to:

 1) Turn it on in Settings → System → Keyboards → Manage keyboards, and enable "Ultra Keyboard" there.

 2) When typing text anywhere (a message, a search box), press and hold the keyboard-switch button (the globe icon on the space bar, or long-press the space bar) and choose "Ultra Keyboard".

 The keyboard has 12 keys like old phones: press a number several times in a row to cycle through letters (e.g. 2, 2, 2 = c). Wait a moment and the letter confirms itself. The Ć/Č key switches between Cyrillic and Latin script. The smiley key opens emoji, the star key opens symbols.
No log yet - try the keyboard first
Symbols - tap for letters. Long-press for the full symbol panel

Microphone not allowed — voice input won\'t work
Sound and vibration: ON (tap to turn off)
Sound and vibration: OFF (tap to turn on)
Speed: FAST - reacts as soon as you touch (tap for another mode)
Speed: MEDIUM - reacts when you lift your finger (tap for another mode)
Speed: STANDARD - double-tap like the rest of the system (tap for fast)

Keys 2-9: press repeatedly in a row to cycle the letter (e.g. 2,2,2 = c). Wait a moment and the letter confirms itself.

 Key 1: punctuation (period, comma, question mark...).

 Key 0: space (first press), digit 0 (second press).

 Key *: cycles through three modes - Letters, Numbers, Symbols. In Symbols mode, a long press opens the full panel of about 30 symbols.

 Key #: Shift - short press for next letter uppercase, long press for Caps Lock.

 ⏎ (top row, above 1): new line.

 🎤 (top row, above 2): voice input.

 ⌫ (top row, above 3): deletes. Hold for fast repeated deleting.

 😀 and ⚙ (second top row): emoji and settings - both intentionally require a real double-tap, so they don't get mixed up with the other keys.

 Capitalization turns on automatically at the start and after a period/question mark/exclamation mark, and is always announced as "uppercase X".

 In Settings you can choose: typing speed, keyboard size (Small/Medium/Large), sound/vibration, script.
